title: Eight cyclic fields with occupancy after exact noise-weight removals

claims.statement: The explicit 8-field degree-125 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-28 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 70993081716285887/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=153258719451358086516489089450000157109365831414407006 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(176679/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all ten averaged pair cutoffs (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3).
